module_summary: Traffic light controller: a red/green/yellow FSM sets pre-lamp registers, a down-counter reloaded on lamp edges times each phase, and pass_request shortens green.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Idle/red/green/yellow sequencer; sets pre-lamp registers and advances when cnt reaches 3.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Phase down-counter reloaded on lamp transitions, drives state changes and clock output.

anchors.name: red
anchors.why: Registered red lamp output from p_red.

anchors.name: yellow
anchors.why: Registered yellow lamp output from p_yellow.

anchors.name: green
anchors.why: Registered green lamp output; also gates pass_request counter shortening.

anchors.name: pass_request
anchors.why: Pedestrian request reloading cnt to 10 during long green.

anchors.name: p_green
anchors.why: Representative pre-lamp register set by FSM; feeds lamp and counter-reload edge detect.

groups.name: light_fsm
groups.description: Phase FSM producing pre-lamp red/yellow/green registers.

groups.name: phase_timer
groups.description: Down-counter reloaded per phase, shortened by pass_request, exported as clock.

groups.name: lamp_outputs
groups.description: Output lamp registers delayed one cycle from pre-lamp registers.
